change: Product safety in Northern Ireland: the guides now say that the EU General Product Safety Regulation has applied in Northern Ireland since 13 December 2024. They previously described the older UK-wide rules as applying everywhere.

pages: Landed cost: freight, duty and VAT
change: Import VAT: corrected to say it is normally reclaimable by VAT-registered businesses, so it affects cash flow rather than cost, and no longer counts towards the UK and overseas cost comparison for them.

pages: Funding routes in the UK and Northern Ireland
change: R&D tax relief: eligibility wording narrowed so it no longer suggests most product development qualifies; the guide points to official guidance and advice.

Corrected an example about confusing margin and markup that overstated the effect on target cost.
